title: Regional General Manager Airports
description:
Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

  • Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
  • Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
  • Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
  • Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
  • Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
  • Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 3+ years Airports leadership experience required
  • Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships.
  • Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget.
  • Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities.
  • Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels.
  • Post-secondary education with a business application an asset.
  • Ability to manage multiple leaders and locations simultaneously.
  • Proficient in PC based applications, Microsoft Project, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to travel & spend time away for significant periods of time.
  • Project management skills considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of International regulations and guidelines (for example - TSA/Civil Aviation, UK High Commission etc.) an asset.
  • Proven track record of effectively influencing leadership teams via handling partners and developing strong direct leadership teams.
  • IATA SGHA experience would be beneficial.

The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:

  • A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
  • Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
  • Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs

Think weâre a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. Weâre Canadaâs leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet'sâ¯Alcohol and Drug Policy.â¯

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply â even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

We value the time and effort you put into your application. Our recruitment process is highly competitive and while every applicant will receive communication regarding their application status, only those selected to move forward will be contacted with next steps. If this role isnât the right fit, we encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.

About

For more information about everything WestJet, please visit westjet.com/aboutus.

If you wish to withdraw your application or request that your personal information be deleted, please contact us at talent@westjet.com.

title: Sales Development Representative Outbound
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. Weâre a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agreesâ our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About The Role

As a Sales Development Representative, your primary responsibility will be to secure meetings with top prospective companies and individuals. You'll work closely with one paired Account Executive to generate meetings from their target account list. We encourage account development through outbound prospecting, social selling, networking, attending conferences and field marketing events, and any sales activity that would contribute to expanding the Tremendous brand. You will be the first line of engagement with prospective customers and will have an impact on Tremendousâ revenue growth and future success.

What You'll Do

  • Work primarily to bring in new deals through Outbound prospecting.
  • Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing and Customer Success teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business.
  • Use Outreach, LinkedIn, your own network, and other prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging.
  • Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

What You'll Bring

  • 2-3 years of prior sales experience, ideally in a similar outbound or SDR role.
  • Clever and creative problem solving. We're small and emphasize output and iteration over a sales handbook set in stone.
  • Independence. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.
  • Collaboration. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.
  • Ability to thrive with a well-set quota. We want our goals to be fair and achievable. You should find these goals alongside your team and with your manager and use them as a benchmark for success.
  • Ambition. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You'll work at a company growing quickly yet sustainably. Weâre profitable with plenty more opportunity ahead. Thatâs good news for your career growth.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $65,000 - $70,000 plus commission.
  • Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Location

This role is remote-first and you can work wherever you want in the Americas. That said, we have a preference for SDRs based in the Austin or New York areas. There may be opportunities to train and collaborate together in person throughout the year.

Compensation Range: $65K - $70K

title: Admissions Advisor MasterClass Executive
description:
Who we are:

MasterClass is the platform where the worldâs best come together so anyone, anywhere, can access and be inspired by their knowledge and stories. We put you in the room with the creators, thinkers, makers and leaders who have changed the world, so that you can change yours.

MasterClass Executive is our selective, cohort-based program for senior professionals learning to lead in the AI era, taught by world-class operators and academics in collaboration with the University of Chicago Booth School of Business and OpenAI. Admission is competitive: applications are reviewed individually, and spots in each cohort are limited.

Â 

About the Role:

We're hiring an Admissions Advisor as a temporary, full-time employee to support our next enrollment cycle. You'll spend most of your day on the phone and in the inbox with applicants and admitted candidates â answering questions about the program experience, helping them weigh the value of enrolling, and guiding them from admission to enrollment ahead of cohort deadlines. You'll also support employer-sponsored enrollment: equipping candidates to make the case to their company and responding to inquiries from managers, HR, and L&D teams.

This is a high-volume, goal-driven role during our busiest enrollment windows. The ideal candidate is a natural on the phone â consultative, warm, and credible with senior professionals â and genuinely fluent in both AI and the business-education landscape. You know what programs like ours cost, what the alternatives promise, and how to have an honest conversation about fit and value.

Â 

Â What You Will Do:

  • Own a high volume of admissions calls â scheduled consultations and proactive outreach with applicants and admitted candidates â answering questions about the curriculum, live sessions, AI Labs, in-person intensive, time commitment, and cohort experience
  • Help prospective enrollees evaluate the program's value: speak confidently and accurately to outcomes, program fees, and payment options, and position MasterClass Executive honestly against the alternatives candidates are weighing (executive education, MBA programs, certificates, and cohort-based courses)
  • Guide admitted candidates from decision to enrollment with timely phone and email follow-up through each enrollment window, identifying and removing blockers before deadlines
  • Run point on employer-sponsorship communications: respond to sponsorship inquiries, provide candidates with materials to secure company support (manager emails, ROI summaries, program overviews), and flag multi-enrollee company interest to our partnerships team
  • Manage your pipeline with clean notes and reliable follow-through; meet daily and weekly contact and response-time goals
  • Log the questions, objections, and sponsorship themes you hear and share them weekly with the admissions and marketing teams to sharpen FAQs, call guides, and email copy
  • Provide surge coverage during peak moments: post-webinar follow-up, enrollment-deadline outreach, and inbox support

Â 

About You:

  • 3+ years in admissions or enrollment advising, inside sales, account management, or another phone-forward consultative role â executive education, higher ed, edtech, or premium consumer experience is a plus
  • Genuinely energized by phone time: you listen first, handle objections without a hard sell, and are comfortable with 20â30+ meaningful conversations a day
  • A strong writer who can run a high-volume inbox with responses that are crisp, warm, and never read like a template
  • Conversant in AI: you follow the space, use the tools yourself, and can speak credibly with senior professionals about how AI is changing their work (no technical background required)
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to navigate uncertainty
  • Fluent in the business-education landscape â executive education, online MBAs, certificates, and cohort-based programs â and how buyers compare them
  • Organized and self-directed: strong CRM hygiene, pipeline discipline, and comfort being measured against clear goals
  • Adaptable in a fast-moving environment where call guides, offers, and priorities evolve week to week
  • Available across U.S. time zones, including some early-evening hours when candidates are most reachable

Â 

Employment Details:

  • Temporary, full-time employment via our staffing partner TCW Global with an anticipated initial assignment of approximately one month; MasterClass may extend the assignment in its discretion based on cohort needs and business demand
  • Employment is at will; nothing in this posting guarantees employment for any specific period or any extension of the assignment
  • Remote (U.S.)
  • Temporary, Full-time, ~40 hours/week, nonexempt (overtime eligible)
  • Pay: $28/hour base pay, plus eligibility for variable incentive pay, subject to terms of a written incentive plan provided at the time of hire (with estimated total on-target earnings of up to $12,000 monthly on target earnings, inclusive of base pay)
  • Benefits: The selected candidate will be employed through our third-party staffing partner, TargetCW, and is not eligible for MasterClass employee benefits (including health insurance, paid time off, and retirement plans). Sick leave and other benefits required by applicable law will be managed directly by TargetCW.

Â 

At MasterClass, we believe we put our best work forward when our employees bring together ideas that are diverse in thought. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. In addition, MasterClass will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.Â  If you have a disability or special need, we would like to know how we can better accommodate you.

title: Associate Events Social & Influencer Marketing
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:


Society 18 is seeking a highly organized, creative, and proactive Associate of Events, Social & Influencer Marketing to support the agency's creator partnerships, experiential marketing initiatives, social media presence, and day-to-day operations.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves bringing ideas to life, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and is passionate about influencer marketing, social media, events, and creator culture. The Associate will work cross-functionally across events, social media, talent, partnerships, and operations while helping execute high-impact campaigns and experiences for creators and brand partners.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


Social Media Marketing & Content Creation

  • Manage day-to-day content planning for Society 18's Instagram and LinkedIn channels.
  • Develop monthly content calendars aligned with agency campaigns, partnerships, creator announcements, and events.
  • Write engaging social media copy, captions, and assist with music selection for short-form content.
  • Design graphics in Canva, including creator announcements, milestone graphics, birthday posts, event promotions, partnership assets, and press announcements.
  • Film and edit Instagram Reels, creator spotlights, event recap videos, and partnership content using CapCut.
  • Maintain Instagram feed planning and overall visual consistency.
  • Schedule and publish content across social media platforms.
  • Publish Instagram Stories daily.
  • Engage with creators, brand partners, and community members through comments and direct messages.
  • Maintain creator posting trackers to ensure balanced representation across agency channels.
  • Develop quarterly newsletters and email marketing campaigns in Flodesk.
  • Create LinkedIn content highlighting agency partnerships, company milestones, leadership updates, and industry news.
  • Build and maintain creator pages on the Society 18 website.
  • Update creator biographies, follower counts, categories, and roster information as needed.


Event Production & Experiential Marketing

  • Assist with planning and executing creator dinners, networking mixers, brand activations, gifting experiences, industry events, and experiential campaigns from concept through post-event reporting.
  • Develop and maintain event production documents, including run-of-show schedules, timelines, itineraries, outreach trackers, and production checklists.
  • Research, source, and coordinate event venues, restaurants, and vendor partners.
  • Build and maintain agency venues and preferred vendor databases.
  • Coordinate pricing, proposals, availability, contracts, and logistics with vendors.
  • Support sponsorship outreach and assist in preparing partnership proposals and presentations.
  • Manage creator invitations, RSVPs, guest lists, and attendee communications using CreatorIQ, Partiful, Airtable, and Google Sheets.
  • Coordinate gifting logistics, product shipments, and vendor deliveries for events.
  • Prepare Independent Contractor Agreements (ICAs), NDAs, vendor agreements, and supporting documentation.
  • Organize event assets, contracts, invoices, presentations, production documents, and creative files in Dropbox.
  • Provide on-site event support, including setup, vendor management, guest check-in, production coordination, and event breakdown.
  • Capture behind-the-scenes photo and video content for real-time social media coverage.
  • Create post-event recap presentations in Canva and track creator coverage using Archive.


Influencer Marketing & Brand Partnerships

  • Pitch creators for brand activations, networking events, creator trips, fashion weeks, festivals, and industry experiences, including ESSENCE Festival, New York Fashion Week, Coachella, and other cultural moments.
  • Support creator onboarding by updating internal databases, website profiles, onboarding materials, and social media assets.
  • Assist with proactive creator pitching for paid brand partnerships.
  • Support talent scouting initiatives and maintain the agency's talent scouting database.
  • Research new creators, emerging trends, and partnership opportunities.


Executive & Administrative Operations

  • Coordinate meetings, calendars, and scheduling with creators, brands, vendors, and internal team members.
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture notes, and distribute follow-up action items.
  • Maintain internal databases, presentations, production trackers, reporting dashboards, and operational documents.
  • Research and source brand contacts across beauty, fashion, travel, hospitality, wellness, food & beverage, and lifestyle industries using Apollo, Airtable, LinkedIn, and additional research tools.
  • Support day-to-day agency operations and assist with special projects as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Event Management, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 1â3 years of experience in influencer marketing, social media, events, talent management, PR, or a related field.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong creative eye for branding, design, and social content.
  • Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:


The ideal candidate is creative, resourceful, highly organized, and excited to help build meaningful experiences for creators and brand partners. They enjoy bringing ideas to life, solving problems, collaborating across teams, and staying on top of emerging social and cultural trends. They are equally comfortable planning an event, editing a Reel, coordinating logistics, mentoring interns, or supporting creator partnershipsâalways with a positive attitude and strong attention to detail.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Join us at Sparksoft, where we're not just another tech companyâwe're a catalyst for change. Our mission isn't just to offer IT solutions; it's to revolutionize the way you work. Here, passion isn't just a buzzword; it's the fuel behind groundbreaking ideas and transformative technologies. We serve a wide range of government clients, delivering impact that's felt across the nation.

Our true strength lies in our people. They're the problem-solvers and innovators consistently delivering extraordinary outcomes. With Sparksoft, you're not stepping into a routine job; you're joining a team committed to innovation and excellence. Our innovation extends beyond just delivering projects. Through our specialized Innovation Centers, we continuously refine our methods, ensuring we remain industry leaders.

We are Sparksoft!

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Data Analyst will be part of a team supporting all phases of the design, development and implementation of a program supporting CMS. Will participate in design sessions, report on project progress, and identify potential risks and issues. The Data Analyst will also be responsible for providing technical direction and guidance to support the data warehouse application process for multiple stakeholders and continuous process improvement in managing and processing data efficiently. Responsible for analyzing and interpreting complex data sets and queries to assist in decision-making. The analyst will have experience with data validation to support regular and ad hoc data requests.

  • Assists users in analyzing and interpreting complex data sets and queries to assist in decision-making
  • Evaluates data anomalies to ensure data quality
  • Performs ad hoc data analysis for predictive analytics and fraud analytics using machine learning
  • Provides guidance for Development and O&M database engineers
  • Experience with big data platform and building data-driven applications using Scala, Python and Java
  • Supports the program in the collection, validation, and reporting of metrics
  • Provide data collection, verification, and analysis for reporting
  • Analyze, evaluate, and recommend processes to best support customer programs
  • Advanced Excel expertise required including use of pivot tables, formulas, conditional formatting, etc.
  • Review and understand artifacts related to data ingestion and transformation as it applies to data validation and analysis
  • Provide quality assurance support using tools like Excel, SharePoint, Power BI, and Tableau
  • Streamlines internal processes focusing on organization support using tools like Excel, SharePoint, Power BI, and Tableau
  • Performs ad hoc data analysis to support programmatic questions and stakeholder requests

title: This IS Your Dream Job
description:
Here are two questions to ask yourself: 1) when are you most content? (Not âhappyâ per se, since happy moments are fleeting. 2) Does contentment ever happen for you during the workday?

The average American worker spends 2080 hours per year on paid work. Over 30 years, that adds up to 62,400 hours. Thatâs a LOT of time to spend doing something you donât like doing.

Research also shows that people will change careers at least 7 times during their lifetime. However, career changes arenât always drastic â you can change the focus of your daily work activity without changing jobs. Sometimes incremental shiftsâsmall changes in what you do and how you do itâare the best and most satisfying way to land that dream job

The key is to concentrate on ways to shift paid job duties into activities that give you that feeling of contentment.

Grab a Sheet Of Paper And a Pencilâor Open Up Your Favorite Word Processor And Work Through The Following Steps To Come Up With Your Own Action Plan To Realize Your Dream Job

STEP 1: Think about your current job â make a list of the tasks that comprise your job. Highlight the ones you most enjoy performing in your job. Note the ones you canât stand

STEP 2: Make a list of activities youâve done in the past that you are most proud of, and that you got the most satisfaction from. These can come from previous jobs, volunteer activities, school work, or hobbies. If you loved laying out the college newspaper, but hated the organizational aspects such as chasing people down to get their content in on time, then that tells you something about the types of activities that work for you.

STEP 3: Envision your ideal job â and list the tasks that it would encompass. What basic skills involved in your ideal job could start working on today? This could be something simple â if your ideal job is to be in charge of all written communication for your organization, an area you could start working on immediately is your writing skills. Even if your current writing skills are pretty good, there is always room to work towards a higher level of achievement.

STEP 4: Now take the list of tasks and activities from steps 1 & 2 above, along with the list of skills from step 3, and group them into functions related to your job that you could concentrate on. (For example, if you are a financial analyst, but you find the grind of financial reports tedious, but you love creating charts and graphs and putting together presentations that visually demonstrate trends â your tasks and activities list could include âcreating graphs & chartsâ, and one skill that could be on your list is âEnhance MS Excel charting & graphing skillsâ.

STEP 5: Conduct some research into the training available out there that would help you to enhance the skills you outlined in step 3. This could involve a number of options â anything from volunteering with an organization in a capacity where you could practice your skills, to taking webinars, intensive workshops, certificate programs, or working toward a degree.

STEP 6: Using the information you gathered in step 5 above, get started with the training program(s) that will meet your individual needs. Remember that you can start small and fine-tune your training plan as you go along. You can also mix and match various training components â it doesnât have to be a straight path, as long as it gets you to where you want to go. Get involved with online forums and interest groups that will help you learn more about the latest techniques in your area of interest. As you spend more time learning and practicing, your skills will improve.

Never underestimate the value of volunteering without asking for additional compensationâ¦your boss and superiors will be impressed that you are interested enough to take on a project without asking for something in return. Showcase your best efforts by volunteering to work on projects that will give you a chance to demonstrate your expertise.

Land Mines to Avoid

Being your own worst enemy â downplaying your talents wonât get you noticed or into consideration for that great new project. Toot your own horn and let others know that you are good at xyz (in the example above, creating charts and graphs). Just as important, offer to help others with that task â soon you will become the resident expert, the one that others turn to for help and advice on this topic

Being finished with learning â remember learning doesnât stop because you have that framed diploma. Keep taking courses, attending seminars and staying in touch with others in your field so that you stay at the leading edge of knowledge and practice in your area of interest

Getting stuck in a rut â Sometimes it seems easier to lay low and just plod along. But you canât stay still â keep looking for new opportunities to apply your talents and showcase them in new and interesting ways.

Decide what you like (and what you donât), do your homework, work hard at new opportunities and advertise the resultsâbefore you know it, youâll be living your dream job.

Contributor: Julie Clarke, Vancouver Island University (www.pr.viu.ca/techcomm)
